name: Visibility Feedback with Screen Space Subdivision
definition: A feedback mechanism that uses visibility information gathered during rendering to optimize data management in out-of-core volume rendering. It prevents wasting GPU memory resources and bandwidth by only refining nodes marked as visible in the previous frame, avoiding the inefficiency of discovering occluded areas only at rasterization time after data is loaded.
summary: Visibility Feedback with Screen Space Subdivision optimizes out-of-core volume rendering by using screen-space subdivision to schedule occlusion queries, preventing the loading of occluded data before rasterization.
